mcp_remote_connection: Connect to the remote MCP server

condition_help: These rules apply only when this option is selected. Removing a rule keeps the remaining groups intact.
condition_sold_out: Sold out · unavailable in a selection
condition_invalid: Check the option and rule structure. AND and OR need 2–8 items, with at most 8 levels and 64 nodes per expression.
condition_product_limit: This product can have at most 1,024 condition nodes in total. Reduce its conditions before saving.

condition_not_scope: The condition below must not be true

condition_upgrade_error: This editor cannot preserve the saved conditions. Reload and use an up-to-date editor.

prompt_load_error: The editor could not be loaded. You can retry without losing your text.

customer_intro: Your favourite places, always with you.
customer_empty: Scan the QR code on the restaurant’s iPad with your phone to add your membership card here.
customer_consent_intro: Set this up once. On your next visit, just scan the QR code on the iPad to join.
customer_consent_companions: Members joining the same visit can see who came together and the table’s orders. Turning sharing off hides your identity in their history.
customer_consent_use: During your visit, selecting you on the iPad lets the service use your history and memories at this restaurant. Others at the table can see and hear the response.
customer_consent_save: Preferences you share during your personal service are remembered automatically. You can view, edit and delete them on your phone.
customer_consent_change: Your data stays separate for each restaurant. You can change these permissions in your membership settings at any time.
customer_use_memories: Use my history and memories during visits
customer_leave_notice: Your personal data will no longer be used or automatically saved for service. Your identity will be hidden in companions’ history. The restaurant retains its order and bill records.
customer_install_title: Add to your phone’s home screen
customer_install_steps: On iPhone, use the Share menu in Safari. On Android, use your browser’s menu to add this app to your home screen.
customer_shared_orders_note: These are the table’s orders, separate from your personal food and drink record.
customer_scan_again: This QR code could not be verified. Please scan the current code on the restaurant’s iPad.
customer_scan_phone: Scan with your phone to remember your visit
customer_scan_hint: Everyone at the table can scan this code.
customer_target_hint: Select a person to use their history
customer_memories_note: Preferences you share during service are saved automatically according to your consent settings. Review, edit or delete them here.
customer_consumption_note: Record what you tried from your visit orders. Changes do not affect the venue’s orders or bill. Set the quantity to zero to remove an item from what you tried.
customer_points_future: Changes apply to future visits. Current visits and awarded points keep their existing rules.
customer_points_rate: Points per visit or spending unit
customer_points_allocation_note: The bill after discounts and adjustments is shared equally between eligible members for rewards. This is separate from what each person paid. Remaining yen go in joining order; points are rounded down.
customer_points_negative: Points from future visits will offset this shortfall.
customer_coupons_empty: You do not have any coupons yet.
customer_exchanges_empty: No coupons are available to exchange at the moment.
coupon_terms: One coupon per bill. Cannot be combined, transferred or exchanged for cash.
coupon_version_note: Changes apply to future issues. Existing coupons retain their image and terms.
coupon_request_hint: Choose a table you have joined to use a coupon.
coupon_bill_note: Cancel the coupon application before changing orders or the bill amount.
coupon_revoke_note: Revoking a coupon does not refund exchanged points. Record any necessary correction in the points ledger.
theme_logo_hint: The square store logo. Configure the wide header banner and organisation icon separately.
theme_assets_hint: Register transparent artwork and textures for use on components.
theme_protection_hint: Change the appearance while keeping header, voice and ordering controls available.
theme_css_hint: Style published parts with colours, borders, shadows, fonts and registered images. Hiding or repositioning controls is not supported.
theme_draw_hint: Drag on the image to add a region, then choose a product. You can also adjust the coordinates below.
theme_draft_hint: Changes are saved as a draft and appear on the ordering screen only after publication.
theme_staged_hint: Apply pending image changes before saving.
theme_import_icon: Import organisation icon as store logo
theme_import_source: Logo imported from the organisation profile
theme_composition_hint: Place your logo above the menu and arrange flyers across one or two columns. Header controls keep their positions.
theme_masthead_visible: Show the store logo and name above the menu
theme_tile_size: Tile width (px, blank for original size)
theme_image_width: Image width (%, blank to follow fit)
evaluation_intro: TableCast is an AI service and ordering system for restaurant iPads. Discuss dishes, customise your choices and review your order in Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese or Korean.
evaluation_start_note: No registration or device pairing needed. Choose 佐藤 晴香 (Haruka Sato) on the sign-in screens.
evaluation_step1_title: Sign in with the demo account
evaluation_step1: Press Choose a demo account, then select 佐藤 晴香 (Haruka Sato). You do not need your own Google account or password.
evaluation_step2: The Komorebi restaurant demo opens. Start voice, allow microphone access and ask for a recommendation. A quiet place and headphones help.
evaluation_step3: Tap dishes to change quantities and options. Review your order and explicitly confirm it before it is submitted. You can also use the screen without a microphone.
evaluation_try2: Add one of those to my basket.
evaluation_try3: I would like to review my order.
evaluation_controls: Try switching languages, stopping and resuming voice, and combining speech with taps. Stopping voice keeps your basket.
evaluation_staff: View table orders, staff calls and bills on the floor screen. Manage dishes and AI service settings under Menu & service. MCP & Skills explains how to connect external AI tools to restaurant operations.
evaluation_safety: This evaluation environment uses fictional restaurants and products. Orders, bill requests and staff calls in the ordering demo do not reach a real restaurant, and no real payments are taken.
evaluation_shared: This is a shared demo account. Please avoid entering personal information or changing account and restaurant settings.
evaluation_login_note: Open the simulated sign-in screen below and select 佐藤 晴香 (Haruka Sato). You do not need a personal Google account, email entry or password.
billing_ai_hint: AI voice sessions cannot be started yet. We will retry automatically. On-screen ordering and store management are still available.
billing_period_hint: Usage for the selected month. Unconfirmed usage may change.
billing_estimate_hint: The base fee is charged when you subscribe and at each monthly renewal. AI usage is settled at the end of the billing period. Amounts shown are provisional; invoices include final charges, tax, refunds and adjustments.
billing_empty: No AI usage in this period
billing_not_configured: Billing is being set up. Subscription management will be available when ready.
billing_price_unavailable: The base fee could not be retrieved. Refresh to try again.
billing_voice_hint: Time spent in voice sessions between customers and the AI.
billing_responses_hint: AI tasks such as checking the menu or preparing an order. This is different from the number of conversation turns.
billing_output_hint: The amount of text produced by the AI during these tasks.
billing_tokens_hint: Tokens measure the amount of text handled by the AI. Input includes information such as menus and conversations; output is the result generated by the AI. Text usage contributes to the AI usage charge alongside voice time.
billing_calendar_hint: Calendar-month totals, shown separately from your subscription billing period.
billing_cycle_charge: AI usage in this billing period
billing_cycle_charge_hint: Usage accumulated so far in the current billing period, excluding the base fee.
billing_cycle_pending: The billing period is not yet confirmed. Check your subscription under Manage payments and subscription.
billing_final_date: Paid plan ends · final usage settlement
billing_base_hint: A fixed monthly fee, with AI usage charged separately.
billing_free_hint: Use menus, ordering and store management for free.
billing_paid_hint: AI voice assistance alongside all Free features.
billing_free_no_card: Free has no time limit. Choose the paid plan when you want to use AI voice assistance.
billing_plans_hint: One subscription per organisation. Moving to Free cancels the paid subscription.
billing_feature_voice: AI voice assistance in Japanese and English
billing_feature_ai: Menu guidance and ordering through conversation
billing_free_ai: AI voice assistance requires the paid plan.
billing_metered_hint: AI usage is charged according to voice session time and the amount of text read and generated by the AI.
billing_free_scheduled: Moving to Free at period end
billing_cancel_how: How to move to Free or cancel
billing_cancel_steps: Select Move to Free · cancel subscription, then confirm cancellation in Stripe. AI remains available until the current billing period ends. Usage is settled at period end, then your organisation continues on Free at ¥0 per month.
billing_cancel_effect: AI remains available until this date. Menus, ordering and store management continue for free afterwards. AI usage up to period end is included in the final bill.
billing_usage_hint: Usage by table and visit for the selected month. AI usage amounts are estimates and exclude the base fee.
billing_daily_hint: Each day runs from midnight to midnight in Coordinated Universal Time.
billing_daily_keyboard: Use the left and right arrow keys to choose a date.
billing_daily_charge_hint: Daily usage charges exclude the base fee, tax and adjustments.
